title: Anchoring Refusal Direction: Mitigating Safety Risks in Tuning via Projection Constraint
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanism of LLM safety (the 'refusal direction') and proposes a training constraint to prevent models from losing their safety alignment during fine-tuning. It evaluates safety in terms of refusal of malicious or harmful instructions rather than evaluating moral reasoning, religious content, or specific ethical frameworks.
